pipeline.modality: Fully human EGFRvIII x CD3 bispecific T-cell engager (BRiTE platform) co-administered with manipulated polyclonal T cells; designed for CNS delivery beyond the blood-brain barrier
pipeline.license_origin: Licensed from Duke University; collaboration with Duke researchers

indications.trial_name: BRiTE — Bispecific T Cell Engager for Patients With Glioblastoma
indications.trial_design: Investigator-initiated open-label Phase 1; lead sponsor Mustafa Khasraw (Duke), Adaptin Bio collaborator; start 2026-04, primary completion 2027-12
indications.lead_sponsor: Mustafa Khasraw, MBChB, MD, FRCP, FRACP (Duke University); Adaptin Bio collaborator
key_milestones: First-in-human dosing planned to commence April 2026; primary completion projected Dec 2027
